say:1:1721509001:1.text: Excuse me, I'm Gwyneth from the Royal Guard.
say:1:1721509001:1.source_cn: 抱歉打扰了，我是守备军的格温妮丝。

say:2:1721509002:1.text: Ah! You startled me! Captain Gwyneth? What brings you here?
say:2:1721509002:1.source_cn: 啊！吓到了我……原来是守备军的格温妮丝队长啊。你怎么来...

say:3:1721509003:1.text: I'm here to gather information on Magister <style="highlight">Cassadee</style> regarding Princess Peggy's disappearance.
say:3:1721509003:1.source_cn: 我是为了佩吉公主失踪一案来的。我需要核实关于随行法师—...

say:4:1721509004:1.text: As her colleague, what's your impression of her?
say:4:1721509004:1.source_cn: 阁下是她的同僚，平时觉得她是个什么样的人？

say:5:1721509005:1.text: Cassadee? She's really nice! She doesn't talk much and spends most of her time reading, but she's the only one here willing to help me with proofreading.
say:5:1721509005:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂啊？她可是个大好人！虽然话不多，总是埋头看书，但...

say:6:1721509006:1.text: The others... they want nothing to do with me, saying I'm too clumsy. Anyway, Cassadee's incredibly hardworking, always the first in and the last out.
say:6:1721509006:1.source_cn: 不像那边那几个……老是嫌弃我笨手笨脚的。总之，她非常勤...

say:7:1721509007:1.text: She's diligent and unassuming... Has she shown any unusual behavior lately? Or been in contact with anyone suspicious?
say:7:1721509007:1.source_cn: 勤奋、低调……那她最近有什么异常举动吗？或者接触过什么...

say:8:1721509008:1.text: Not at all. Her routine is as regular as clockwork! If she's not at the library or out on duty, she's here studying magic.
say:8:1721509008:1.source_cn: 完全没有。她的生活简直比炼金时钟还规律。除了去图书馆和...

say:9:1721509009:1.text: Sounds like she's very dedicated to her work. When did she begin serving as a court mage?
say:9:1721509009:1.source_cn: 这么看来，她确实很优秀。那她是什么时候加入的宫廷魔法师团？

say:10:1721509010:1.text: Since she took first place in the recent selection exam of the <style="highlight">Serene Lyceum</style>.

say:12:1721509012:1.text: Yes, that exam was a major event! Even the Queen and Princess Peggy attended.
say:12:1721509012:1.source_cn: 对啊！那次选拔我印象可深了！规模很大，连王后陛下和佩吉...

say:13:1721509013:1.text: <style="highlight">Magister Cyran</style> went there several times as well. It was so good when he wasn't around—I could finally rest... I mean, work at my own pace!

say:14:1721509014:1.text: Anyway, Cassadee's victory was no easy feat, especially with a member of House Hastings among her competitors.
say:14:1721509014:1.source_cn: 与她同场竞争的还有黑斯廷斯家族的小少爷，结果……嘿！科...

say:15:1721509015:1.text: Did anything out of the ordinary take place during her time here?
say:15:1721509015:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂就职后呢，有没有什么特别的事？

say:16:1721509016:1.text: Hmm, I don't think so. She doesn't seem to be in Magister Cyran's good graces, so she's mostly stuck with menial paperwork.
say:16:1721509016:1.source_cn: 唔，那倒是没有，毕竟首席好像不是很喜欢她，平时只丢给她...

say:17:1721509017:1.text: If that's the case, why was she assigned to escort Princess Peggy during the festival? Isn't that an important duty?
say:17:1721509017:1.source_cn: 既然如此，这次升华庆典这么重要的场合，为什么是科丝蒂跟...

say:18:1721509018:1.text: Oh, that one I know! Princess Peggy made a special request for Cassadee's service.
say:18:1721509018:1.source_cn: 哦，这个我知道！这是公主殿下自己的要求。公主殿下好像很...

say:19:1721509019:1.text: I see. Thank you for sharing this, Magister Dali. I'd like to take a look at Cassadee's desk. Could you point me to it?
say:19:1721509019:1.source_cn: 我明白了。多谢你的情报，达利阁下。科丝蒂的工位在哪里？...

say:20:1721509020:1.text: The tidiest one in that corner! I just hope Cassadee's alright...
say:20:1721509020:1.source_cn: 就在那边角落里！最整齐的那张桌子就是！唉，希望她没事！
